podcast.title: Roots in The Beatles' Arrival (1964)
podcast.body: Progressive country is believed to coincide with, or be a result of, The Beatles' arrival at JFK Airport in New York on February 7, 1964. Their influence encouraged baby boomers to challenge norms, and progressive country is seen as part of that cultural pushback against established styles, particularly Nashville's polished country sound. "I believe that progressive country, if not the result of the very least coincides with the arrival of the Beatles at JFK Airport in New York on February 7th, 1964."

podcast.title: Arrival in 1974
podcast.body: Progressive country music emerged in 1974, coinciding with the inaugural year of the PBS television program "Austin City Limits."
